cookies.necessary_description: Necessary cookies help make a website usable by enabling basic functions such as page navigation and access to secure areas of the site. The website cannot function properly without these cookies.
cookies.ad_user_data_description: Allows your data to be used for advertising purposes.
cookies.ad_personalization_description: Shows advertising tailored to your interests.
cookies.analytics_storage_description: Collects statistics to improve your experience.
cookies.functionality_storage_description: Stores preferences to improve the functionality of the website.
cookies.personalization_storage_description: Adapts content according to your preferences.
cookies.security_storage_description: Ensures the security and integrity of the website.
